newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MITI says sentiment at small firms sluggish.
newsitem.headline: Japan MITI says sentiment at small firms sluggish.

text.p: Trade Minister Shinji Sato said on Thursday that business sentiment at small and medium-sized Japanese firms was sluggish and that the ministry would keep close watch on the situation.

Asked about business sentiment at such firms at a key parliamentary committee meeting, Sato said: "Capital spending at small and medium-sized firms is sluggish. Overall, it (sentiment) is stalled and we will keep close watch on this."
